filtro_cabina.name: Cabin filter (A/C)
filtro_cabina.notes: The A/C never goes off in the DR

refrigerante.name: Coolant (flush)
refrigerante.notes: The level gets checked in the inspection, not here

correa_accesorios.name: Serpentine belt
correa_accesorios.notes: Check it at every oil change

correa_tiempo.name: Timing belt
correa_tiempo.notes: Only if the engine runs a belt, not a chain

bateria.name: Battery
bateria.notes: In this heat, 2–3 years is typical

cambio_gomas.name: New tires
cambio_gomas.notes: By age: 6–10 years depending on the DOT date

marbete.title: Marbete
marbete.notes: The window opens in late October and closes January 31.

licencia.title: Driver's license
licencia.notes: Check for unpaid tickets before you renew.

revision_tecnica.title: Technical inspection
revision_tecnica.notes: Waiting on INTRANT to roll it out.

aceite.label: Engine oil
aceite.how: Cold engine on level ground: the dipstick reads between Min and Max. Check the color.

coolant.label: Coolant
coolant.how: Cold engine only: the level sits between Min and Max on the plastic tank. Never open the radiator cap hot.

frenos.label: Brake fluid
frenos.how: Reservoir between Min and Max; the color should be clear or amber.

direccion.label: Power steering fluid
direccion.how: If it is hydraulic, check the dipstick or the reservoir against its Hot/Cold marks.

atf.label: Transmission fluid (ATF)
atf.how: Only if it has a dipstick: engine warm, idling, in P; check level and color. Dark or smelling burnt means trouble.

bateria.label: Battery
bateria.how: Terminals tight and free of white or green crust.

filtro_aire.label: Air filter
filtro_aire.how: Pull it and hold it up to the light: if no light gets through or it is black, replace it. On dusty roads, check it twice as often.

ds3_sa_ep6.sources: PSA platform data (DS3) · PSA oil spec for the EP6

ds3_sa_thp.sources: PSA platform data (DS3) · PSA oil spec for the EP6

coolantColorNote.label: Coolant color is not a standard: go by the technology your manual calls for.

carro_diario__0.label: Leaks under the car
carro_diario__0.how: Look at the ground where the car sat overnight.
carro_diario__0.warning: Green, orange or pink puddle = coolant; black or brown = oil; red = transmission or power steering. Clear is almost always A/C water, and that is normal.

carro_diario__1.label: Dash warning lights
carro_diario__1.how: Key to ON, then make sure every light goes out once the engine starts.
carro_diario__1.warning: Temperature climbing, coolant gauge, oil can, battery, check engine or brake.

carro_diario__2.label: Tires (visual)
carro_diario__2.how: Look for bulges, cuts, nails or a tire that is obviously low; check the wear pattern.
carro_diario__2.warning: A bulge in the sidewall, wear on the edges (alignment) or in the center (too much air).

carro_diario__3.label: Brakes (feel)
carro_diario__3.how: First stop of the day, at low speed: firm pedal, no pulling, no noise.
carro_diario__3.warning: Spongy pedal, pulls to one side, squeal or grinding, vibration.

carro_semanal__0.label: Coolant
carro_semanal__0.how: Cold engine only: the level sits between Min and Max on the plastic tank. Never open the radiator cap hot.
carro_semanal__0.warning: Below Min, topping up often (leak), rusty or oily coolant, sweet smell, steam.

carro_semanal__1.label: Engine oil
carro_semanal__1.how: Cold engine on level ground: the dipstick reads between Min and Max. Check the color.
carro_semanal__1.warning: Below Min; milky (coolant in the oil); black and gritty.

carro_semanal__2.label: Washer fluid
carro_semanal__2.warning: Empty. Water with washer soap is enough; no antifreeze needed here.

carro_semanal__3.label: Tires (visual)
carro_semanal__3.how: Look for bulges, cuts, nails or a tire that is obviously low; check the wear pattern.
carro_semanal__3.warning: A bulge in the sidewall, wear on the edges (alignment) or in the center (too much air).

carro_semanal__4.label: Lights
carro_semanal__4.how: Test headlights, brake, reverse and turn signals against a wall or with a helper.
carro_semanal__4.warning: A burned-out bulb; cloudy or yellowed lens.

carro_semanal__5.label: Brakes (feel)
carro_semanal__5.how: First stop of the day, at low speed: firm pedal, no pulling, no noise.
carro_semanal__5.warning: Spongy pedal, pulls to one side, squeal or grinding, vibration.

carro_semanal__6.label: Air conditioning
carro_semanal__6.how: Turn it on: the air should come out clearly colder than the cabin.

carro_semanal__8.label: Papers up to date
carro_semanal__8.how: Insurance current, marbete current and your license in the car.
carro_semanal__8.warning: Expired means a ticket at the next stop.

carro_mensual__0.label: Tire pressure (spare included)
carro_mensual__0.how: Cold, with a gauge, all 4 plus the spare, per the door-jamb sticker.
carro_mensual__0.warning: One tire 2–3 psi under the rest is a slow leak. Losing ~1 psi a month is normal.

carro_mensual__1.label: Tread depth
carro_mensual__1.how: Coin test or check the wear bars. The legal minimum is 1.6 mm.
carro_mensual__1.warning: Wear bars flush with the tread, uneven wear.

carro_mensual__2.label: Brake fluid
carro_mensual__2.how: Reservoir between Min and Max; the color should be clear or amber.
carro_mensual__2.warning: Dark brown, or the level dropping (worn pads or a leak).

carro_mensual__3.label: Power steering fluid
carro_mensual__3.how: If it is hydraulic, check the dipstick or the reservoir against its Hot/Cold marks.

carro_mensual__4.label: Battery and terminals
carro_mensual__4.how: Terminals tight and free of white or green crust.
carro_mensual__4.warning: Slow crank, dim lights, battery light.

carro_mensual__5.label: Belts and hoses
carro_mensual__5.how: Cold engine: squeeze the hoses (firm, not soft, not rock hard); the belt has no cracks or glazing.
carro_mensual__5.warning: Squeal on startup, cracks, swelling near the clamps, coolant crust.

carro_mensual__6.label: Wipers
carro_mensual__6.how: Run them with washer fluid: they should wipe clean without streaking or chattering.

carro_mensual__7.label: Spare, jack, lug wrench and triangle
carro_mensual__7.how: Make sure they are there and the spare has air.
carro_mensual__7.warning: The spare goes flat on its own and nobody remembers it.

diesel_semanal__0.label: Coolant
diesel_semanal__0.how: Cold engine only: the level sits between Min and Max on the plastic tank. Never open the radiator cap hot.
diesel_semanal__0.warning: Below Min, topping up often (leak), rusty or oily coolant, sweet smell, steam.

diesel_semanal__1.label: Engine oil
diesel_semanal__1.how: Cold engine on level ground: the dipstick reads between Min and Max. Check the color.
diesel_semanal__1.warning: Below Min; milky (coolant in the oil); black and gritty.

diesel_semanal__2.label: Fuel water separator
diesel_semanal__2.how: Drain it when the water-in-fuel light comes on, and at every oil change.
diesel_semanal__2.warning: Diesel quality varies here, so check it even if the light stays off.

diesel_semanal__3.label: Air filter (visual)
diesel_semanal__3.how: Take a close look if you drive dusty or rural roads.
diesel_semanal__3.warning: Turbo diesels are very sensitive to dust.

diesel_semanal__4.label: Intercooler and radiator face
diesel_semanal__4.how: Make sure they are not clogged with mud, leaves or bugs.
diesel_semanal__4.warning: They block airflow and heat the engine when towing or climbing.

diesel_semanal__5.label: Glow plug light
diesel_semanal__5.how: It should go out before you crank.
diesel_semanal__5.warning: Long crank = glow plugs or fuel delivery.

diesel_semanal__6.label: Tires (visual)
diesel_semanal__6.how: Look for bulges, cuts, nails or a tire that is obviously low; check the wear pattern.
diesel_semanal__6.warning: A bulge in the sidewall, wear on the edges (alignment) or in the center (too much air).

diesel_semanal__7.label: Brakes (feel)
diesel_semanal__7.how: First stop of the day, at low speed: firm pedal, no pulling, no noise.
diesel_semanal__7.warning: Spongy pedal, pulls to one side, squeal or grinding, vibration.

motor_prerodaje__0.label: Tires and wheels
motor_prerodaje__0.how: Tread and cold pressure; spokes and rims without cracks; pad condition.
motor_prerodaje__0.warning: Low pressure, bent rim, pads at the limit.

motor_prerodaje__1.label: Controls
motor_prerodaje__1.how: Bars straight and free; cables well routed and lubed; the throttle moves freely and snaps closed.
motor_prerodaje__1.warning: Revs rising on their own when you turn the bars.

motor_prerodaje__2.label: Lights and electrical
motor_prerodaje__2.how: Battery terminals clean and tight; headlight aimed; tail lights and turn signals; switches and mirrors.
motor_prerodaje__2.warning: A light that will not come on, a bare wire.

motor_prerodaje__3.label: Stands
motor_prerodaje__3.how: Side stand and center stand: springs all there and undamaged.
motor_prerodaje__3.warning: A stand that does not flip up on its own when you ride off.

motor_semanal__0.label: Oil and fluids
motor_semanal__0.how: Engine oil, gearbox oil, brake or clutch hydraulic fluid, coolant if it is liquid-cooled, and fuel.
motor_semanal__0.warning: Leaks at gaskets, seals or hoses.

motor_semanal__1.label: Chassis and chain
motor_semanal__1.how: Frame without cracks, steering bearings, suspension, chain tension and lube, fasteners.
motor_semanal__1.warning: Lube the chain every ~500 km or after rain.
